data.revised_prompt:
Create exactly one 1536x1024 PNG sprite sheet, clean HD pixel-inspired 2D game FX-only animation. Arrange exactly 12 equal frames in an invisible 3 rows x 4 columns grid (each frame 384x341.33), left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Entire canvas background is 100% solid flat #FF00FF magenta, including all space between cells. No visible grid lines, no borders, no guide marks, no labels, no UI, no numbers, no text, no watermarks.

Subject: Jay J, Dragon Prince elite enemy card-collection attack FX only: “Royal Table Seizure.” Do NOT draw Jay, no character body, no dragon head/face/eyes/claws/hands/armor/cloak/shoulders/weapons/creature silhouettes/full dragon. It is not dragonfire, not a projectile. It is a macro elite table-wide effect forcibly collecting all table cards at once.

Palette/theme from elite dragon prince reference: electric cyan, deep blue, ivory white, gold royal sigils, polished aquatic energy, calm ceremonial authority. Card style: actual playing-card silhouettes, white card faces with simplified red/black pips and indices, ocean-blue ornate card backs, rounded card corners, readable table-card shapes. Do not make tarot cards, scrolls, paper sheets, coins, UI panels, labels.

Style: polished clean HD sprite with pixel-inspired crisp edges, sharp details, clean edges, high contrast aquatic blue/cyan/white/gold palette, readable cards, sharp motion arcs, smooth glow, no painterly scene, no realistic smoke, no background elements. Cards are the dominant subject; gold law-circle geometry and cyan-blue suction trails support movement. All FX centered in each cell with similar approximate scale; fit fully within cell with clear magenta margin; no element touches or crosses cell edges.

Frame details:
1. Wide table-field omen: 6 to 8 visible playing cards scattered in a broad arc, faint gold royal decree circle underneath, small cyan spark at center.
2. Cards wake up: every card gains cyan outline and tiny gold corner sparks; cards remain readable and separate.
3. Lift phase: cards rise and tilt toward center, thin blue suction lines connect them to central seal.
4. Command phase: larger gold law circle opens behind cards, card backs and faces begin rotating inward.
5. Pull phase: cards from outer left and right sweep inward along curved cyan trails, still at least 5 visible cards.
6. Strong suction: cards accelerate into a spiral vortex, motion trails stretch behind each card, gold card-shaped light shards appear.
7. Peak collection: many cards orbit rapidly around bright blue-white center inside a large gold royal seal, widest and strongest frame, macro elite pressure.
8. Compression: cards stack and fold into center as if being taken into Jay's pile, cyan vortex and gold rings squeeze tight.
9. Capture snap: card mass collapses into white-blue flash, several card silhouettes still visible at edge of seal.
10. Aftershock: cards are gone; broad gold seal, cyan spiral residue, small card-shaped light fragments remain.
11. Residual claim: fading royal sigil, a few blue motes and gold card fragments drift inward, empty table feeling.
12. Loop-ready fade: faint central cyan star and thin gold decree circle, no cards left, ready to disappear.

Ensure exactly one sprite sheet image only. No characters or body parts. No visible guide template. Use crisp pixel-inspired sprite FX rendering, not photorealistic.
